Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: 8 mm S275 steel | Process/finish: laser/waterjet rough + bore/face finish
Overall: X 8.000 × Y 150.000 × Z 76.000 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: guide bore Ø34.60 +0.10/0; 2×Ø6.6 rail holes; datum face flatness 0.10; bore position ±0.10; cold axial travel ≥1.50 mm; no axial clamp
GD&T/datums: A=profile mounting plane; B=barrel axis; C=rear axial datum; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; barrel-axis alignment; sliding travel and cold/hot
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Artifact check: PASS only; fabrication HOLD pending full v0.8 gates. Physical NOT_RUN; machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
